title: Carnage Mathcounts
text:
Carnage Middle School is a North Carolina MathCounts powerhouse, located in Raleigh NC of Triangle Chapter Mathcounts. Ever since the introduction of its 'double math' program, many mathematically talented students around the county have attended this school, and thus, the beginning of the Carnage Mathcounts program.
